correctness.rationale: For d>=6, the six contact conditions are the moments of at most six distinct ratios v_i/p_i. The corresponding square Vandermonde matrix is invertible over C, forcing every equal-ratio coordinate block to have zero Fermat sum and at least two indices. Conversely the Fermat restriction along a block direction is exactly t^d times the unused-coordinate power sum. The irreducible open parameter spaces have dimension (|T|-k-1)+(k+6-|T|-2)=3, and the unique generic ratio-partition separates components. Exhausting nine block-size types yields polynomial 15d^3+45d^2+90d+51. Full mathematical proof in RESULT.md; verify_components.py independently counts admissible partitions. No infinite claim depends only on numerical tests.
